description_en: Checks whether target instances are supported by SysOM
description_zh: 检查目标实例是否被 SysOM 支持
kebab_example: aliyun sysom check-instance-support --biz-region cn-hangzhou --instances i-2zxxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: CheckInstanceSupport

parameters.help_en: The list of instance IDs to check
parameters.name: instances

parameters.help_en: The region to which the instances belong. Make sure that all instance IDs specified in instances belong to the same region
parameters.help_zh: 实例所属 Region，务必保证 instances 中传递的所有实例ID都属于同一个 region
parameters.name: region

code.description_en:
The status code.
If `code == Success`, the authorization is successful.
Other status codes indicate authorization failed. Check the `message` field for the detailed fault information
code.description_zh:
状态码
`code == Success` 则代表授权成功；
其它状态码代表授权失败，授权失败时查看 `message` 字段获取详细的错误信息；

reason.description_en: The reason why the instance is not supported for management. This value is not empty when support is false
reason.description_zh: 当success为false时，该值不为空，表示不支持被纳管的原因
reason.title_en: 当success为false时，该值不为空，表示不支持被纳管的原因
reason.title_zh: 当success为false时，该值不为空，表示不支持被纳管的原因

support.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance is supported for management by SysOM.

true: The instance is supported for management by SysOM.

false: The instance is not supported for management by SysOM
support.description_zh:
是否支持被 SysOM 纳管

true：支持被 SysOM 纳管

false：不支持被 SysOM 纳管
